title.narrative: 102 IMMUNIZATION AND OTHER COMMON CHILDHOOD ILLNESSES

description.narrative: By 2022, government and partners have institutional capacity to ensure pregnant women, infants and children from marginalized and at risk groups, especially the girl child have equitable availability, access, knowledge and demand for quality health care services for immunization as well as prevention and treatment of other childhood illnesses including pneumonia, diarrhoea, malaria and paediatric HIV, in selected states.
